outlook.statement: The Company expects that with a stable and a reformed government at the center, there will be positive growth and further rationalization of capital market, which will lead to more investment, value creation, capitalization and thus the additional wealth for investors and see better prospects in near future. Also, with the growing economy there will be more opportunities for financing which will prove beneficial for our company. The Company expects better results in near future in anticipation of the policy reforms combined with the dedication of the highly motivated team with excellent understanding of the operations along with magnificent customer relation skills.

The overall forecast for the coming years appears positive with growth rates for many Eurozone economies revised upwards; in EMDEs, pickup of growth in commodity exports is expected to boost growth to an average of 4.7% in 2023-24. Indian economy expected to grow at 7 to 8.25% during FY 2024-25. Business opportunities for finance companies are enormous as new areas and segments are being explored; rural middle income boom has led to rise in rural incomes; per capita GDP growing faster in rural areas than urban centers; new opportunities like home equity, personal finance, factoring and bill payment for rural hard-to-reach customers may take the company to new scales of success.
